newsitem.title: USA: TIG Q4 oper shr rises.
newsitem.headline: TIG Q4 oper shr rises.

text.p: Oper shr $0.65 $0.53
Year
Oper shr $2.45 $2.00
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Net income was $38.9 million, or $0.67 a share, in 1996 Q4 compared with $33.5 million, or $0.54 a year ago.
1996 Q4 operating income excludes after-tax net investment gains of $800,000 or $0.01 a share vs gains of $600,000 or $0.01 a share a year ago.

1996 Q4 results included pre-tax catastrophe losses of $2.1 million, or 0.02 a share on an after-tax basis, compared with pre-tax catastrophe losses of $9.3 million, or $0.10 a share on an after-tax basis, in the year ago quarter.
Net income for the full year 1996 was $78.9 million, or $1.30 a share, compared with $118.2 million or $1.89 a share a year ago.

The full year operating income excludes realized after-tax net investment losses of $2.7 million or $0.05 a share compared with realized after-tax net investment losses of $7.0 million or $0.11 a share in 1995.
Full year operating income also excludes a 1996 first quarter restructuring charge of $65 million, net of tax.
The combined ratio in the 1996 Q4 was 103.1 percent compared with 103.4 percent a year ago.
For 1996, the combined ratio was 105.0 percent compared with 105.3 percent a year ago.
Net premiums written in the 1996 Q4 were $345 million compared with $375 million a year ago.
For 1996, net premiums written were $1.53 billion compared with $1.61 billion in 1995.
TIG Holdings Inc.
